team.name: Jerry Cooper, CPA, CFF
team.role: Certified Public Accountant and Certified Forensic Accountant
team.bio: Jerry Cooper has been a Certified Public Accountant in the State of Texas for over 20 years and is also a Certified Forensic Accountant. He has worked as an accountant and auditor for various small to medium public accounting firms, and for large oil and gas corporations in the Houston area as well as abroad. He has extensive experience in accounting for small and large companies and in preparing tax returns for high net-worth individuals and corporate clients with complicated tax issues. He graduated from the main campus of the University of Houston in 1999 with a double major bachelor's degree in Accounting and Finance, and is a member of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants as well as a member of the Texas Society of CPA's.
